newsitem.title: USA: U.S. RICE WEEKLY EXPORT SALES HIGHLIGHTS--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. RICE WEEKLY EXPORT SALES HIGHLIGHTS--USDA.

text.p: USDA rice export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Sales for the 1997/98 marketing year (MY), which began (Aug. 1) were 125,600 MT. The major buyers were Belgium (57,500 MT), Canada (19,400 MT), Saudi Arabia (17,200 MT), Honduras (8,900 MT, of which 8,700 MT was rough), Switzerland (3,900 MT), Mexico (3,000 MT, of which 2,600 MT was rough), and El Salvador (2,500 MT--all rough).
A total of 65,100 MT were outstanding on July 31 (the end of the 1996/97 marketing year) and were carried over to 1997/98.

Exports for the week were 34,000 MT, with Syria (14,100 MT), the Netherlands (8,800 MT), and Mexico (3,000 MT) the major destinations. Accumulated exports for the year were 2,254,200 MT--down 12 percent from the 2,564,400 MT exported during the previous year.
Rough (Paddy) Rice: A total of 546,500 MT of rough rice was exported during the 1996/97 marketing year.

Long grain rough rice shipments of 482,100 MT were to Mexico (274,300 MT), Costa Rica (54,700 MT), Colombia (34,400 MT), Guatemala (30,800 MT), El Salvador (20,800 MT), Nicaragua (20,700 MT), Peru (13,100 MT), Spain (12,500 MT), Honduras (10,800 MT), Venezuela (8,100 MT), and the Netherlands (1,700 MT) while shipments of 64,400 MT of short and medium rough rice were to Turkey (59,700 MT) and Mexico (4,700 MT).

Beginning outstanding balances of rough rice total 36,100 MT, including long grain rice for Mexico (18,400 MT), Honduras (8,700 MT), and El Salvador (7,300 MT) and short and medium grain rice for Mexico (1,400 MT) and Honduras (400 MT).
